description: Search the OpenAlex catalogue of scholarly papers by keyword, look papers up by DOI, list the papers that cite one work, or list a university's or journal's papers. Returns title, authors, year, citation count, DOI, abstract and a free full-text link when one exists.

cited_work.description: cited_by mode: a DOI or OpenAlex id; returns the papers that cite it

dois.description: doi mode: up to 25 DOIs or OpenAlex ids, separated by commas

from_year.description: Only papers published this year or later

include_abstract.description: false to leave abstracts out (default true)

institution.description: institution mode: a name, a ROR id or an OpenAlex id; the best name match is used and echoed in matched_entity

min_citations.description: Only papers cited at least this many times

mode.description: search (default when query is given), doi (default when dois is given), cited_by, institution or source

open_access_only.description: true to keep only papers with a free full text

query.description: Keywords, for example graph neural networks. Double quotes match a phrase. Required for search; narrows institution and source results

sort.description: relevance (needs query), citations, newest or oldest

source.description: source mode: a journal name, an ISSN or an OpenAlex id

to_year.description: Only papers published this year or earlier

work_types.description: Comma separated: article, preprint, review, book, book-chapter, dissertation, dataset, report, letter, editorial, standard, other

name: search_papers
title: Search academic papers
